description: Source code for a Zephyr EFI loader implementation for x86 architecture, including EFI table handling, memory setup, and entry point logic.

methods.name: efi_putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character to EFI console, buffering until newline or buffer full.

methods.name: efi_guid_compare
methods.description: Compares two EFI GUIDs for equality.

methods.name: efi_config_get_vendor_table_by_guid
methods.description: Retrieves vendor table pointer by GUID from EFI configuration tables.

methods.name: efi_prepare_boot_arg
methods.description: Prepares EFI boot arguments by locating RSDP via GUIDs.

methods.name: disable_hpet
methods.description: Disables the HPET timer to prevent spurious interrupts.

methods.name: efi_entry
methods.description: Main entry point for EFI bootloader, performs memory setup, disables HPET, and jumps to Zephyr kernel.
